meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让系统自动跑实验,持续优化代码与模型效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总在反复调参做实验,希望系统自动帮你找到更好的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run iterative experiments to keep improving your code and model results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of manually tweaking models and want the system to find the best approach for you

howto.what: Claude会充当协调者，把改进目标拆成“假设树”，派出多个子代理在隔离的git分支上并行做实验，只在通过独立测试评估器时才合并改动，最终产出改进后的工件、测试分数和完整实验记录。
howto.when: 当用户想通过多轮实验迭代改进某个具体工件（如代码、训练配方、agent框架、数据管道等），且有可打分的目标和评估器时触发；即便没提“Arbor”，只要描述反复实验-评估的循环也会触发。

say.text: 改进这个数据生成管道，用下游模型评分当评估器，跑10轮实验。
say.note: 每次实验都会在隔离分支进行并记录。

say.text: 帮我在MLE-bench任务上搜索最佳方案，别过拟合dev集。
say.note: 并行探索多个假设，只在测试集通过才合并。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as coordinator: builds a hypothesis tree of improvement ideas, runs parallel subagent experiments in isolated git worktrees, and merges changes only when they beat a held-out test evaluator. It outputs the improved artifact, test score, and a full experiment log.
howto.when_en: When the user wants iterative multi-experiment improvement of an artifact (code, recipe, harness, pipeline) against an evaluator, even without mentioning Arbor — e.g. repeated experiment-evaluate loops or overfitting worries.

say_en.text: Use Arbor to improve my agent harness: raise test-set accuracy, with dev/test evaluators.
Improve this data pipeline using downstream model score as evaluator, run 10 cycles.
say_en.note: Each experiment runs in an isolated branch.

say_en.text: Search for the best MLE-bench approach without overfitting the dev set.
say_en.note: Explores options in parallel; merges only if test gate passes.
